stories.title: Patrick Mahomes stars for Chiefs, strikes early connection with Josh Downs
stories.summary: Even with an elbow injury, Patrick Mahomes was able to have his best performance of the year to lead the Chiefs to a dominant 35-13 win over the Falcons.
stories.detail: ATLANTA -- Minutes before Sunday's game against the Falcons , Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes said he felt more nervous than usual. He wondered how well he'd perform while still dealing with a small sprain of his right UCL suffered just seven days ago. But even in unusual circumstances -- and even as injuries with other teammates piled up as the game progressed -- Mahomes was able to have his best performance of the year to lead the Chiefs to a dominant 35-13 victory . Mahomes used his talented right arm, while wearing a Hyperice elbow sleeve to reduce inflammation between drives, to throw for a season-high 348 passing yards and five touchdowns. "You don't know until you get out there and that adrenaline starts kicking in," Mahomes said, smiling. "Obviously, it was good enough. We did a great job, [athletic trainer] Julie [Frymyer] and the whole training staff all week of just trying to make sure I was in a great spot to go out there and compete. "I'm sure we'll have some ice on it going back home. We'll continue that same process next week." stories.title: Jets QB Geno Smith suffers ankle injury, replaced by rookie Cade Klubnik
stories.summary: Jets quarterback Geno Smith suffered an ankle injury in the third quarter and was replaced by rookie Cade Klubnik on Sunday at MetLife Stadium.
stories.detail: EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. -- The New York Jets , mired in a historic offensive funk, have a new concern on their long list: an uncertain quarterback situation. Geno Smith injured his left ankle in the third quarter of the Jets' 31-12 loss to the Buffalo Bills and left MetLife Stadium on a golf cart Sunday evening after a brief stop in the X-ray room. There were no crutches and no visible walking boot. Coach Aaron Glenn didn't provide an update after the game. The Jets turned to rookie Cade Klubnik , who made his NFL debut after riding the bench for nine weeks. The former Clemson, facing a 17-12 deficit when he entered the game, threw an interception and was sacked three times as the spiraling Jets (2-8) lost their fifth straight. They haven't scored a touchdown in nine quarters, tied for the second-longest drought in the NFL this season and their longest since 2023. "Bad ball. Bad football. Not a recipe to win," wide receiver Garrett Wilson said. Things were so bad for the Jets that they became only the second team this century to lose back-to-back games by at least 17 points despite having four scoring drives in each game. teamStories.summary: — Drew Lock passed for 240 yards and two touchdowns, including a game-breaking 71-yard scoring toss to Jaxon Smith-Njigba, and the Seattle Seahawks beat Las Vegas 21-13 on Sunday to spoil the debut start of Raiders rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza.
teamStories.detail: LAS VEGAS -- — Drew Lock passed for 240 yards and two touchdowns, including a game-breaking 71-yard scoring toss to Jaxon Smith-Njigba , and the Seattle Seahawks beat Las Vegas 21-13 on Sunday to spoil the debut start of Raiders rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza . The defending Super Bowl champion but injury-riddled Seahawks (6-4), playing their first regular-season game at Allegiant Stadium, have won three of four entering their bye week. Las Vegas (4-6), which lost standout tight end Brock Bowers to a right ankle injury , has lost six of seven. Facing Seattle's Dark Side defense, even in the venue known as the “Death Star,” figured to be a demanding obstacle for Mendoza. The top pick in this year's draft, elevated after Kirk Cousins was traded Tuesday to Minnesota, looked sharp early in leading the Raiders to 10 points on their first two drives. But then the Seahawks suffocated Mendoza, sacking him six times and holding him to 143 yards passing. Mendoza relied on his legs, rushing six times for 22 yards, including a 10-yard quarterback draw to punctuate the Raiders' first drive. teamStories.summary: The Seahawks dominated the 2nd half to get a second straight win heading into their badly needed bye week.
teamStories.detail: The Seattle Seahawks (6-4) will go into the bye week feeling good. They overcame a slow first half to put away the Las Vegas Raiders (4-6) and send rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza to defeat in his first career NFL start. Seattle trailed 10-7 at the break before unleashing hell on Earth in the second half, racking up over 300 yards of offense after halftime, while the Raiders had negative yards until their last possession. The 21-13 scoreline didn’t accurately reflect the closeness of the game, as Seattle had its wasteful moments that took points off the board. Drew Lock was far more aggressive and inventive than he was last week against the Arizona Cardinals, an indicator that his right elbow is getting better. He threw two spectacular scramble drill touchdowns to Cooper Kupp and Jaxon Smith-Njigba, although he did lose a couple of fumbles on some unusual plays. Lock’s “dagger” was taking a naked bootleg for 15 yards to pick up a first down and deny Vegas any chance of a miracle comeback. stories.title: Which NBA players have the most triple-doubles of all time?
stories.summary: Russell Westbrook holds the NBA record for most triple-doubles in a career. See who else joins him on the list.
stories.detail: Russell Westbrook has more than earned the nickname Mr. Triple Double. In basketball, a triple-double is when a player compiles a double-digit total in three of five statistical categories (assists, blocks, points, rebounds and steals) over the course of a game. Blocks and steals were officially recorded by the NBA starting in the 1973-74 season. No player in NBA history has recorded more triple-doubles than Westbrook. On May 10, 2021, Westbrook became the NBA's career leader in triple-doubles, tallying 28 points, 13 rebounds and 21 assists for the Washington Wizards in a 125-124 loss against the Atlanta Hawks . It marked the 182nd triple-double of Westbrook's career, passing Oscar Robertson for the most on the all-time list. Assist your wardrobe with NBA gear from Fanatics Nikola Jokić also has since passed Robertson, whose record stood for more than 47 years. Westbrook had already broken Robertson's record for the most triple-doubles in a single NBA season (41), recording 42 during the 2016-17 campaign. stories.title: Celtics set franchise mark with 42-9 lead over Mavericks after one quarter
stories.summary: The Celtics led the Mavericks 42-9 at the end of the first quarter Sunday, the largest scoring margin in a quarter since 1987.
stories.detail: BOSTON -- The Celtics led the Dallas Mavericks 42-9 at the end of the first quarter Sunday, marking the franchise's largest lead at the end of the period in franchise history. It's the best scoring margin by any team in any quarter since 1987, when the Los Angeles Lakers outscored the Sacramento Kings 40-4 in the first quarter. It's also tied for the third-best mark by any team in a quarter in the shot clock era, according to ESPN Research. The Celtics have led by at least 40 points in two other games this season, against Charlotte on Nov. 6 (46 points) and Chicago on Oct. 26 (40 points). Playing on four days' rest, the Celtics sprinted out to a 24-4 advantage, with Derrick White (11) and Jordan Walsh (eight) scoring 19 of those points. The Mavericks, who lost in Cleveland on Saturday, looked sluggish throughout the opening period Sunday, missing 16 of their 18 field goal attempts and going 0-for-8 from the 3-point line. By contrast, Boston shot 59% and knocked down seven 3s. The Celtics took a 67-37 lead into halftime. The Associated Press contributed to this report.

stories.detail: INGLEWOOD, Calif. -- — Darius Garland scored 27 points, Max Strus had 14 off the bench and the Los Angeles Clippers beat the Charlotte Hornets for the 17th straight time with a 113-105 victory Sunday. Derrick Jones Jr . and Isaiah Jackson each scored 13 points, while Keaton Wagler and Gradey Dick had 12 apiece as the Clippers overcame a 13-point deficit in the third quarter to win for the third time in four games following a 1-7 start. Coby White scored 21 points and Naz Reid added 17 for the Hornets, who lost for the eighth time in their past nine games and fell to 0-2 at the start of a four-game road trip. Coach Charles Lee was ejected when he received a pair of technical fouls in a 17-second stretch of the third quarter. The Hornets haven't defeated the Clippers since Nov. 18, 2017. Their last road win in the series was Feb. 28, 2009. While still awaiting the season debut of Brandon Ingram (heel), Los Angeles continued to turn things around after its poor start to the season despite being outrebounded 46-37, while taking 18 fewer shots from the floor than Charlotte. stories.title: Lakers almost blow 31-point lead before escaping Phoenix with a victory
stories.summary: Lakers had a 101-70 lead late in the third quarter before holding off a furious Suns rally. Luka Doncic finishes with 43 points.
stories.detail: Luka Doncic reacts during the first half against the Phoenix Suns on Sunday. (Kelsey Grant / Getty Images) The 31-point lead the Lakers built late in the third quarter looked insurmountable, especially with the tear Luka Doncic was on. But the Lakers learned that no lead is too big in the NBA and the Phoenix Suns were out to show them that. Though the Lakers began to reel as their lead was sliced to five points late in the fourth quarter, they were able to withstand their own inequities and the onslaught from the Suns to hold on for a 131-123 win over Phoenix on Sunday afternoon. Doncic led the Lakers with 43 points and nine rebounds and Quentin Grimes had 22, including a bank-in three-pointer with 32.2 seconds left to ice the game and send the Lakers to their eighth straight win . The Lakers led 101-70 with 1:47 left in the third quarter, the game looking over. But after the Suns cut the lead to nine points in the fourth, Lakers coach JJ Redick called a timeout with 5:02 left. teamStories.title: Spurs win 12th straight while sending Jazz to 12th straight loss
teamStories.summary: — Dylan Harper had 31 points and nine rebounds to rally the San Antonio Spurs to a 110-102 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday, giving them their 12th straight win, while sending the Jazz to a 12th straight loss.
teamStories.detail: SALT LAKE CITY -- — Dylan Harper had 31 points and nine rebounds to rally the San Antonio Spurs to a 110-102 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday, giving them their 12th straight win, while sending the Jazz to a 12th straight loss. Victor Wembanyama finished with 26 points, 11 rebounds, six assists, and five blocks for the Spurs. Stephon Castle added 20 points and nine assists. Keldon Johnson had 11 points and 10 boards. San Antonio outscored the Jazz 27-5 in fastbreak points. Mo Bamba scored 26 points, while going 6 of 6 from 3-point range, to lead Utah. Darryn Peterson scored 17 points for the Jazz. Keyonte George finished with 13 points and eight assists and Brice Sensabaugh added 14 points and seven rebounds off the bench. San Antonio trailed for much of the fourth quarter until Harper tied it at 100 on back-to-back 3s and then Castle hit a pair of free throws to put the Spurs up 102-100 with 2:30 left. Castle’s steal and dunk with 47.2 seconds remaining capped a 14-4 run and extended San Antonio’s lead to 108-102. Utah scored seven baskets over eight possessions, culminating in Mamba’s step-back 3-pointer, to take a 33-23 lead late in the first quarter. San Antonio erased the…
